author: Ogrey
body:
Special thanks to alexanderjoe10 for providing his build server! you rock!



Map Name: Embers II
Map Gamemode: Nebula (DTM)
Map Creators: UmbreonMessiah, iMercury, FlareonMessiah, FlufflesSub

Sequel to Embers (now Embers I), has the same amount of monuments (4) spread across the map, there's three beacons at the top of the gold farms, there's chests containing special items and pretty much a lot of features you'll have to discover because I'm either too lazy to explain or I can't just come up with enough detail to provide, thanks!
